title: doria retrofracta
intro: Doria retrofracta, commonly known as Indian spikenard, is a plant species that belongs to the Araliaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Doria retrofracta include sesquiterpenes, triterpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. Additionally, the plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its therapeutic actions that include antipyretic, anti-rheumatic, and anti-dermatitic properties.
